state:
**Goal `ext-host` — an extension loads under its pin, runs once per request on its request's core, and stays inside that request's budget — is in Stage 2.** The configuration half is done and its check's four named tests run green (`crates/nvs-config/tests/extension.rs`). The design is ADR 0246 §§ 3–6 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*; this goal has no record slot, so a question is decided in `crates/nvs-ext/src/lib.rs`'s module doc.

On disk: `crates/nvs-ext` exists with the engine-free half. `section::read` finds `nvs.manifest` and `nvs.source` at a component's top level through `wasmparser` (refuses a core module, a repeated section, non-wasm bytes); `manifest::Manifest::parse` and `source::Source::parse` read the two JSON payloads, closed keys, format number read first. The module doc in `crates/nvs-ext/src/lib.rs` owns the decisions taken: the manifest model sits behind no feature and wasmtime is the optional dep of the default `engine` feature (a reader that must not link it takes `default-features = false`); a method's WIT export is its name in kebab-case (`Method::export_name`); `nvs.source` is JSON with UTF-8 text. Types stay Novis text in the model; checking them against the WIT table is the loader's. Tests: `crates/nvs-ext/tests/manifest.rs`. No `src/load.rs` yet: nothing reads a `.nvsx` from disk, so `cargo test -p nvs-ext --test load` (check `nvs-ext-loading-refuses-everything-0246-names`) does not exist.

items.text: **Load, in 0246 § 4's order, each refusal naming the entry** — `rule:packaging/extension-loading-is-root-controlled`. Read the file; SHA-256 (`sha2`) against the pin, compared case-insensitively because `crates/nvs-config/src/extension.rs` accepts either case; the component validates (wasmtime `Component::new`, under `#[cfg(feature = "engine")]`); `crates/nvs-ext/src/section.rs:30`'s `read`, then `Manifest::parse` at `crates/nvs-ext/src/manifest.rs:279` and `Source::parse`; every method's `export_name()` exists in the manifest's `interface` with the WIT type `rule:packaging/a-value-crosses-as-its-wit-type`'s table gives its Novis type (a type outside the table refused); every import is in `wit/nvs-ext/world.wit`'s world, refused naming it; the class not under `Core\` or `Novis\`; no other entry in the set declares the class; `manifest.world` is `1.x` with `x` no newer than the host's, refusal naming both. Test guests are component WAT through the `wat` dev-dependency, with the sections added by the `with_section` helper already in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/manifest.rs:11` (copy it to `tests/load.rs`).

backlog: If `load.rs` grows past ~400 lines, split the Novis-type-to-WIT check into its own module behind `engine` (`crates/nvs-ext/src/lib.rs` module doc).
Stage 3, the packer: `crates/nvs-ext/src/pack.rs`, replacing the `with_section` test helper; it must write `nvs.source` files in path order (goal file § Stage 3).
`nvs-types` and the language server take `nvs-ext` with `default-features = false` when goal `ext-compiler` wires them; no `[workspace.dependencies]` entry for `nvs-ext` exists yet.
`tools/nv/test/html-later-polyfill.test.ts:190` failed once with `EBUSY` removing its browser profile on Windows, and passed on the re-run; not investigated (owner: `tools/nv`).
